summary: A container query lets a component change its layout based on the space its container gives it, not the screen width. This page puts the same member card in a wide column and a narrow one so you can see both layouts at once.
notes: Both <article class="member"> cards have identical markup. Only the container around them differs.
The <svg> avatars are drawn inline, with aria-hidden="true" because the name next to them already says who it is.
The .label lines are only there to name each container in the preview.
pitfall: Expecting a container query to work without marking an ancestor as a container. Some ancestor needs container-type in the CSS, or the @container rule never matches.
